newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Two balloonists safe after round-world bid fails.
newsitem.headline: Two balloonists safe after round-world bid fails.

text.p: Swiss balloonist Bertrand Piccard and Belgian Wim Verstraeten touched down in the Mediterranean on Sunday after their round-the-world bid was aborted when fuel from a heating system leaked into their cabin.

An official spokesman for the Breitling Orbiter flight told Reuters from the control centre at Geneva airport that the two were safe and were immediately picked up by helicopters already at the scene off the French coast.
